description: This file defines a test class 'TestAzureTableStorageStreamFailureHandler' that extends 'AzureTableStorageStreamFailureHandler' to handle stream failure scenarios using Azure Table Storage in a testing context. It includes methods for creating instances, retrieving failure counts, and configuring storage options.

classes.name: TestAzureTableStorageStreamFailureHandler
classes.description: A test-specific implementation of AzureTableStorageStreamFailureHandler for handling stream failure entities in Azure Table Storage during testing.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Asynchronously creates and initializes an instance of the failure handler.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of delivery failures for a specified stream provider.

methods.name: GetDataManager
methods.description: Creates and returns a new AzureTableDataManager for TableEntity with the appropriate options.

methods.name: GetAzureStorageOperationOptions
methods.description: Configures and returns AzureStorageOperationOptions with the specified table name.

methods.name: GetStreamingAzureStorageOperationOptions
methods.description: Configures and returns AzureStorageOperationOptions specific to Azure Storage for streaming, with the specified table name.
